article.title: California orders review of AI ‘kill switch’, safety controls
article.author: Editor
article.content: California Governor Gavin Newsom ordered a review of a possible mandatory AI "kill switch," independent audits and incident reporting amid growing concerns over advanced systems escaping human control. The post California orders review of AI ‘kill switch’, safety controls appeared first on MR Online .
